### 1. Architecture Overview
Prometheus’ observability stack is centered on the `model/labels` package: the `Labels` type (currently a sorted slice of `Label` structs) represents the canonical label set used everywhere from ingestion (text parsers, `model/textparse/*`) through relabeling (`model/relabel/relabel.go`), remote write encoding (`prompb/codec.go`, `prompb/io/prometheus/write/v2/symbols.go`), TSDB encoding/indexing (`tsdb/index`, `tsdb/head_*`), symbol-table rebuilding (`tsdb/head_dedupelabels.go`), alerting (`notifier/alert.go`), and schema helpers (`schema/labels.go`). Each component imports `github.com/prometheus/prometheus/model/labels` and treats `Labels` as a sortable, slice-like collection: they iterate with `Range`, construct via `New/FromStrings`, slice for hashing, encode/decode through `Bytes/Hash`, and rely on builders (`Builder`, `ScratchBuilder`) for mutation while preserving ordering (source: `model/labels/labels_slicelabels.go`, `model/labels/labels_stringlabels.go`, `model/labels/labels_dedupelabels.go`, `model/labels/labels_common.go`). Because this type flows through ingestion, storage, indexing, and export, changing `Labels` to a struct with private fields and accessor methods requires updating every file that constructs, indexes into, or directly processes `Labels` slices; otherwise, any direct iteration (e.g., `for _, l := range labels`) or indexing (`labels[i]`) will break.

### 2. Detailed Analysis

**a. Core Labels Implementations (`model/labels/*.go`)**
- `labels_slicelabels.go` defines `type Labels []Label` and exposes methods (`Bytes`, `Get`, `Range`, `New`, `FromStrings`, `Builder`, etc.) that assume slice semantics for iteration, copy, and ordering. The builder and scratch builder mutate and sort the underlying slice (metadata: sections describing `Builder`, `ScratchBuilder`, and methods such as `Copy`, `Range`, `Validate`).  
- `labels_stringlabels.go` and `labels_dedupelabels.go` provide alternative encodings but share the same public `Labels` API (including `MatchLabels`, `Hash`, `BytesWithLabels`, `Compare`, `Range`, `Validate`, `DropMetricName`, `InternStrings`, `Builder/ScratchBuilder`). Each relies on slice-like access for building and iteration (metadata lists exact methods and builder implementations).  
- `labels_common.go` defines the `Label` struct and builder helpers for JSON/YAML marshaling and validation (`Map`, `FromMap`, `NewBuilder`, `Del`, `Keep`, `Set`, `Range`). All references assume straightforward iteration over `Labels`.

**Implication:** Converting `Labels` from `[]Label` to an opaque struct necessitates rewriting all traversal/manipulation APIs (`Range`, `Copy`, `Builder`, `Compare`, `Get`, `Len`, etc.) and exposing accessor methods that hide the underlying data. Builders must still be able to iterate existing entries, so they need to be rewritten to work with the new representation. Tests that assert slice equality (e.g., in `labels_test.go`) will need their helpers updated.

**b. Consumers Across the Stack**
- Ingestion (`model/textparse/openmetricsparse.go`, `model/textparse/interface.go`/tests): these call `Labels` methods to write parsed label sets, typically via `(*OpenMetricsParser).Labels` writing directly into provided `Labels` objects and later hashing them for series identity (see `sectionMap` referencing `Label` extraction and hash). Any direct slice manipulation (e.g., assuming the underlying slice is addressable) will break.
- Relabeling (`model/relabel/relabel.go`): the `Process` and `ProcessBuilder` flow mutates label sets using `labels.Builder` and frequently iterates existing entries (`builder.Range`). Changing `Labels` representation means `Builder` must be rewritten to operate on the struct and internal accessors instead of raw slices, and `relabel.go` must use the new builder/accessor API.
- Remote write (`prompb/codec.go`, `prompb/io/prometheus/write/v2/symbols.go`): both convert between protobuf label pairs and internal `Labels` via functions like `ToLabels`, `FromLabels`, `SymbolizeLabels`, `desymbolizeLabels`. These conversions rely on indexed loops and assume `Labels` exposes a `[]Label` view (for example, iterating over `Labels` to append to slices). The codecs must be updated to use accessor methods (e.g., `Len`, `At`, or iteration callbacks) to remain functional.
- TSDB (e.g., `tsdb/index/postings.go`, `tsdb/index/index_test.go`, `tsdb/head_read.go`, `tsdb/head_dedupelabels.go`): `postings` stores mappings keyed by label names/values, acquired from `Labels`. The `Head` reader/writer code rebuilds symbol tables and iterates labels (`filterStaleSeries` etc.). All these files import `model/labels` and traverse label sets, so they must switch to the accessor-based API (metadata shows they rely on methods like `LabelNames`, `Series`, `SortedPostings`, all of which eventually query `Labels` content).
- Feature/testing/utilities (`model/labels/labels_test.go`, `labels_slicelabels_test.go`, `test_utils.go`, `schema/labels.go`, `schema/labels_test.go`, `util/testutil/cmp.go`, `util/convertnhcb/convertnhcb.go`, `notifier/alert.go`): tests build `Labels` slices directly (e.g., `Labels{{Name: "...", Value: "..."}}`). Schema helpers call `ScratchBuilder` to add metadata labels while guarding overrides.

**Implication:** Every consumer accessing label entries must migrate to the new accessor methods, while tests must be updated to construct label sets via the new API (likely through constructors and builders). Utilities that depend on `Labels` layout (like `SizeOfLabels`, `Compare`) must be ported.

**c. Builders and String Conversion**
- All builders (from `labels_common.go`, `labels_slicelabels.go`, `labels_stringlabels.go`, `labels_dedupelabels.go`) depend on extracting and sorting slices. The new `Labels` struct needs to expose read-only iterators/accessors so builders can still capture existing labels before applying modifications.
- Serialization helpers (`Bytes`, `Hash`, `MatchLabels`, `Get`, `Has`) must operate on the new struct, but callers remain stable if method signatures persist.

### 3. Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| prometheus | `model/labels/labels_slicelabels.go` | Defines the current `Labels` type as `[]Label`, provides core slice-based APIs (`Range`, `Copy`, `Builder`, `New`, `FromStrings`), and exposes builders that must be rewritten to align with the new struct representation (metadata section map details these methods). |
| prometheus | `model/labels/labels_stringlabels.go` | Provides variant implementation that also exposes slice semantics (`Bytes`, `Get`, `Range`, `Builder`, `ScratchBuilder`) and will need refactoring to use accessor-based APIs under the new `Labels` struct (metadata lists all methods that assume slice layout). |
| prometheus | `model/labels/labels_dedupelabels.go` | Alternative label storage relying on encoded slices and exposes identical method names; each method (`Bytes`, `Hash`, `Builder`, `New`, etc.) must be updated to operate on the renamed struct while preserving API signatures (metadata enumerates the extensive API). |
| prometheus | `model/labels/labels_common.go` | Defines `Label`, JSON/YAML marshaling helpers, and builders that assume direct slice iteration; these builders and helper functions must be adapted to the new struct while continuing to support validation and map conversion (metadata provides builder methods like `Del`, `Set`, `Range`). |
| prometheus | `model/labels/labels_test.go` | Contains comprehensive tests that construct `Labels` slices, rely on iteration, and benchmark builders; all assertions refer to slice semantics (metadata outlines numerous `Test`/`Benchmark` functions). |
| prometheus | `model/labels/labels_slicelabels_test.go` | Tests builder behavior that depends on slicing and "safe/unsafe add", must be updated to use the new struct’s accessor API (metadata describes the specific tests). |
| prometheus | `model/labels/test_utils.go` | Provides helper slice types (`Slice`, `Selector`) and functions (`ReadLabels`) that assume `Labels` is iterable; it will need to be updated to use the accessor-based APIs (metadata enumerates the functions). |
| prometheus | `schema/labels.go` | Uses `Labels` builders (`ScratchBuilder`) to inject metadata labels, expecting slice-like behavior; constructors and builders must work with the new struct and use accessor methods (metadata lists functions like `AddToLabels`, `SetToLabels`, `IgnoreOverriddenMetadataLabelScratchBuilder`). |
| prometheus | `schema/labels_test.go` | Validates metadata label interactions using `Labels` builders; these tests must be updated to the new API (metadata lists the relevant tests). |
| prometheus | `model/textparse/openmetricsparse.go` | Parses OpenMetrics text and writes labels via `OpenMetricsParser.Labels`, which currently fills a provided `Labels` (metadata mentions writing into `Labels` struct and extracting names for hashing). Must align with the new struct’s mutation/access API. |
| prometheus | `model/textparse/interface.go` | Defines the `Parser` interface that writes into `Labels` and the factory that constructs parsers; it needs to expose the new accessor-based labels API (metadata describes `Parser` and `New`). |
| prometheus | `model/textparse/interface_test.go` | Exercises parser selection and label output, expecting slice-like `Labels`; tests must adapt to new constructors/accessors (metadata describes the test helpers). |
| prometheus | `model/relabel/relabel.go` | Applies relabeling rules using `labels.Builder` and iterates existing labels; changing `Labels` representation requires updating the builder usage (metadata details `Process`, `ProcessBuilder`, and `builder` operations). |
| prometheus | `prompb/codec.go` | Converts between remote protobuf label arrays and internal `Labels`, looping over entries; these conversion helpers must operate via the new accessor API (metadata calls out `ToLabels`, `FromLabels`). |
| prometheus | `prompb/io/prometheus/write/v2/symbols.go` | Symbolizes `Labels` by iterating over entries and accessing names/values; the `SymbolizeLabels` function must call the new accessor interface instead of indexing into a slice (metadata lists the functions). |
| prometheus | `prompb/io/prometheus/write/v2/symbols_test.go` | Verifies label encoding/decoding; tests must construct label sets via the new struct API and assert the builder works (metadata outlines the tests). |
| prometheus | `tsdb/index/postings.go` | Maintains postings per label pair and iterates label sets when adding/querying; access to label names/values must rely on the new accessor methods (metadata details `Postings`, `Add`, `PostingsForLabelMatching`, etc.). |
| prometheus | `tsdb/index/index_test.go` | Constructs mock indices and label sets to validate postings/index behavior; tests must use the new accessor API (metadata lists numerous test cases referencing labels). |
| prometheus | `tsdb/head_read.go` | Exposes TSDB Head APIs that gather label names/values and iterate series labels; underlying code must continue to work with the revamped `Labels` struct via accessor methods (metadata lists functions like `LabelNames`, `SortedPostings`, `Series`). |
| prometheus | `tsdb/head_dedupelabels.go` | Rebuilds symbol tables by iterating every series’ labels; the `RebuildSymbolTable` helper must read labels through accessor methods and builders (metadata notes `RebuildSymbolTable`, `labels` helper). |
| prometheus | `util/testutil/cmp.go` | Provides test utilities that compare label sets (e.g., `labels.Equal`); comparisons will continue to work once `Labels.Equal` is updated to the new struct, but helper usage may need adjustments if they inspect underlying slices (metadata references `RequireEqual`). |
| prometheus | `util/convertnhcb/convertnhcb.go` | Converts histogram labels, iterating label sets when removing bucket suffixes; must switch to the new accessor API when reading/writing `Labels` (metadata lists functions like `GetHistogramMetricBase`). |
| prometheus | `notifier/alert.go` | Applies relabeling to alert label sets using `labels` and `relabel` packages; iteration and hashing rely on `Labels`’ slice semantics (metadata outlines `Alert.relabelAlerts`). |

> **Note:** The above list includes every file known (from metadata) to import or manipulate `model/labels` directly and/or rely on slice semantics. Changing `Labels` to an opaque struct will impact each file; they must be updated simultaneously to prevent compile/runtime errors.

---

**Action Plan Summary:** Replace the `type Labels []Label` declaration with a struct containing private storage (e.g., `type Labels struct { data []Label }`) and add accessor methods (`Len`, `At`, `Iterator`, `Bytes`, `Copy`, etc.). Update builders to work against the new structure, ensuring methods like `Range`, `Get`, `Has`, and constructors (`New`, `FromStrings`, `Builder`, `ScratchBuilder`) continue to exist but operate on the struct’s private data. Every consumer listed above must use the new accessor methods rather than direct slicing; tests must be updated to use the new constructors/builders rather than literal `[]Label` slices.
